questions.q: What is a lens in CRM Analytics?
options: A permission that controls which apps a user can see
A saved exploration: a query against a dataset shown as a visualization
A scheduled job that refreshes a dataset
A prebuilt dashboard template
questions.explain: A lens is a visualization of a dataset used to explore data graphically. Behind it is a query, and the chart is that query's result.

questions.q: You are looking at a dashboard widget and want to keep exploring its data. What is the fastest way in?
options: Recreate the chart from scratch in a new report
Ask an admin to export the dataset
Use the widget's menu and choose Explore, which opens its query as a lens
Change the dashboard's app folder
questions.explain: The Explore action on a widget opens the underlying query as a lens, so you continue from where the dashboard stopped.

questions.q: In a bar-chart lens, which control sets the field that creates the individual bars, such as Product Family?
options: Bars
Bar Length
Query Limit
Trellis
questions.explain: Bars holds the grouping. Bar Length holds the measure being aggregated, and Trellis splits the chart into small multiples.

questions.q: What does Drill Into This By do after you click a bar?
options: Deletes the selected bar from the dataset
Publishes the lens to every user in the org
Converts the lens into a scheduled recipe
Lets you regroup the selected slice by another dimension
questions.explain: Drill Into This By lists dimensions in the dataset and regroups the selection by the one you choose.

questions.q: Why is it good practice to build a chart in a lens before adding it to a dashboard?
options: Dashboards cannot contain charts unless they came from a lens
You can check quickly that the fields, grouping, and filters tell the story you expect
A lens is required to refresh the dataset
Lenses hide security settings from the dashboard
questions.explain: Exploring first lets you find missing fields, overly granular groupings, or misleading filters before you commit the query to a dashboard.
